incidents.name: Umbrella StakingRewards unchecked stake accounting
incidents.notes: The rewards pool dropped SafeMath on the assumption that stake amounts could not overflow, so a crafted stake wrapped the reward accounting and let the attacker claim rewards far beyond the pool's intended emissions.

sources.ref: onchain review: StakingRewards 0xB3FB1D01B07A706736Ca175f827e4F56021b85dE created 2022-03-14T17:05:30Z by 0xa6e4ffa19b213abea258ae72e8e1a209b9e543e7, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment - the pool was only 5.6 days old. Loss ~700K reported (UMB rewards, drained on both Ethereum and BNB Chain); the Ethereum leg is recorded here.
